description: What Tesseract actually returns for girocard-sample.jpg, recorded from two real runs. The card is a public specimen, the printed IBAN is a dummy: its shape and length are those of a German IBAN, but the check digits '00' can never validate. Note what the engine makes of those two zeros - 'DD' in one reading, 'OD' in the other. Repairing exactly that is what IbanRecognitionHelper.repairOcrConfusions is for.
